@@leveling4@@{{{leveling4}}}@@leveling5@@{{{leveling5}}}@@leveling6@@{{{leveling6}}}@@range@@{{{range}}}@@radius@@{{{radius}}}@@effectradius@@425@@width@@{{{width}}}@@speed@@{{{speed}}}@@casttime@@none@@cost@@100@@cooldown@@140 / 127.5 / 115 / 102.5 / 90@@targeting@@Unit@@damagetype@@Magic@@spellshield@@true@@projectile@@{{{projectile}}}@@notes@@ * '''Camille''' will attempt to basic attack the target upon landing. * '''Camille''' will track the target if they change locations. ** She will always land and create the zone after 0.5 seconds. * If the target becomes [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]], [[File:Death icon.svg|20px|link=Death|An icon representing the keyword Death]] [[:Death|dies]], or moves 2000 or more units away during the dash, it will be interrupted, causing the ''The Hextech Ultimatum'' to be cancelled. ** The zone fails to create in this case. * [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|Knockaway]] speed is 1000. * If the target manages to be outside of the boundaries, they will immediately be pulled back towards the center of the hexagon. * The boundaries are not considered terrain ([[File:Sion Unstoppable Onslaught.png|20xpx|border|link=Sion#Unstoppable Onslaught|An icon for Sion's ability Unstoppable Onslaught]] [[Sion#Unstoppable Onslaught|Unstoppable Onslaught]] exception), and enemies that try to move out of the area will be displaced back inside. ** [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|Dashes]], [[File:Flash.png|20px|link=Blink|An icon representing the keyword Blink]] [[:Blink|blinks]], [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|displacements]], and other forms of movement will cap their effect range to the boundary. Targets will stop at the boundary even after it expired. ** [[File:Ekko OriginalSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Ekko|An icon representing Ekko]] [[Ekko|Ekko's]] [[File:Ekko Chronobreak.png|20xpx|border|link=Ekko#Chronobreak|An icon for Ekko's ability Chronobreak]] [[Ekko#Chronobreak|Chronobreak]] will still deal damage at the hologram's location. ** An active [[File:Vi Cease and Desist.png|20xpx|border|link=Vi#Cease and Desist|An icon for Vi's ability Cease and Desist]] [[Vi#Cease and Desist|Cease and Desist]] on a target outside the perimeter will cause [[File:Vi OriginalSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Vi|An icon representing Vi]] [[Vi]] to continue her charge until ''The Hextech Ultimatum'' ends. She can knockback and damage secondary targets multiple times. ** If the target [[File:You and Me!.png|20px|link=Attached|An icon representing the keyword Attached]] [[:Attached|attaches]] to a unit, they will only be displaced back inside once they detach.
